meaning:
Καναναῖος, -ου, ὁ
(late Heb. קָנָא),
a Cananæan or Zealot (cf. ζηλωτής): Mat.10:4, Mrk.3:18 (Rec. -νίτης).†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: Simon the Zealot; and Judas Iscariot, who also betrayed him.
